inlines.v: EXALTA'TION, noun The act of raising high. 1. Elevation to power, office, rank, dignity or excellence. 2. Elevated state; state of greatness or dignity. I wondered at my flight, and change To this high exaltation 3. In pharmacy, the refinement or subtilization of bodies or their qualities and virtues, or the increase of their strength. 4. In astrology, the dignity of a planet in which its powers are increased.
